title: Peak staffing and launch rally playbook
content:
Purpose and scope:
This brief is a lightweight operational playbook to coordinate a short, company-wide surge (peak staffing) and the associated launch rally for the Q4 feature rollout. Target audience: execs, company-ops, HR/talent, engineering leads, product, marketing, and CS.

Top-level objectives (what 'done' looks like):
- Launch window executed with no P0 incidents and <2x expected latency for 95th pct during traffic spike.
- All onboarding hires (contractors + ICs) cleared and productive on Day 1 of the ramp.
- Clear owner map for comms and run-of-show; <4 escalations to execs across 10-day window.
- Post-launch OKR signal: product adoption + retention safe-guarded (see metrics).

Key metrics to watch (dashboard refs):
- Serving latency p95/p99 (route + global) — target p95 <= 220ms during ramp.
- Token throughput per GPU and per-customer — baseline vs surge delta.
- New hire time-to-first-commit (engineering) and time-to-first-support-ticket-closure (CS).
- Customer error rate (5xx) and fallback invocation percentage.
- Personnel KPIs: offer acceptance rate within 48h, onboarding completion % by Day 2.

Owners & roles (primary/backup):
- Playbook lead: Sasha Patel / backup: Ellen Park
- Engineering surge lead (runtime): Ravi Menon / backup: Tomás Rivera
- Dedicated capacity & infra: Tomás Rivera / backup: Eng Ops oncall
- Talent + onboarding: Priya Desai / backup: People Ops lead (L. Morgan)
- Comms & event ops: Ellen Park / backup: Marketing ops
- Exec escalation: CEO + Head of Eng (on rotation)

High-level timeline (two-week window):
- T-10 to T-7: Finalize hires and contractor confirmations; freeze non-essential infra changes; stability smoke tests.
- T-6 to T-3: Dry run #1 (internal traffic at 60% projected); runbooks validated; comms templates staged.
- T-2: All-hands rehearsal; invite matrix validated; backup capacity confirmed.
- T-1: Final go/no-go review at 10:00 PT (exec + tech leads); rollback plan sanity check.
- Launch day (T): staged ramp (0->25->50->100%) with monitoring gates every 30m.
- T+1 to T+7: Post-launch stabilization, focused bug-fix sprints, onboarding of new hires into support rotation.

Run-of-show (launch day) — abbreviated:
- 07:00 PT: Ops pad opens (infra oncall and surge engineers). Standby channel: #launch-rally.
- 08:30 PT: Exec readout & final health checks (latency, capacity, error budget).
- 09:00 PT: Canary release to 2% traffic for 30m; evaluate telemetry. Gate: p95 < 250ms AND error rate <= baseline+0.5%.
- 09:45 PT: If canary green -> expand to 25% for 60m. If degradation -> rollback and triage window (30m).
- 11:00 PT: Expand to 50% with double-monitor cadence. 12:00 PT: Full open if all gates pass.
- 15:00 PT: Short all-staff sync + highlight any escalations; update public status page if needed.
- 20:00 PT: Nightly wrap + oncall handover.

Rally & comms templates (owner: Ellen):
- Executive announcement: short PRD-style summary + explicit asks for support rotations.
- Internal standup cadence: every 2 hours during ramp; owners must post a short status in #launch-rally.
- Customer comms: pre-announce to top 50 customers + runbook for account teams.
- Scripted public status updates (marketing + support) if we need to notify customers of degraded UX.

Staffing and onboarding notes (owner: Priya):
- Priority hires: runtime capacity engineers (4 ICs), infra SRE (2), CS surge agents (6 contractors).
- Onboarding checklist: access (okta, k8s), local infra quickstart, 1-hr shadow session, assigned buddy + first-issue claim.
- Ramp training: mandatory 90-min workshop for surge staff covering emergency rollback, KV cache impact patterns, and model fallback policies.

Contingency modes (A/B/C):
- Mode A (normal): gates pass; continue staged ramp. Minimal exec involvement.
- Mode B (degraded performance but stable): enable temporary throttling rules, throttle heavy customers via per-route budgets, escalate to SRE lead.
- Mode C (system instability / P0): full rollback to previous model snapshot + execute incident runbook; notify execs and open an incident war room.

Known risks & mitigations: (rapid list)
- Risk: Unanticipated model memory blowup at scale -> Mitigation: pre-staged quantized variant available to fall back; memory alarms trigger auto-evac to fallback pool.
- Risk: Onboarding lag for contractors -> Mitigation: mandatory preboarding session and checklist completion gating active rotas.
- Risk: Customer-facing errors -> Mitigation: early outreach to top customers + reserve dedicated account engineering slots.

Open questions / decisions needed: (to resolve in T-6 review)
- Do we require a hard freeze on all infra PRs starting T-7? (ops preference: yes; release engineering to confirm exceptions).
- Final acceptance criteria for canary beyond latency & error rate (do we add sample-quality checks?).
- Budget approval for contractor headcount (Finance sign-off needed before offers).

Post-launch cadence & OKR linkback:
- Post-launch 30/60/90 retros to produce signal-to-noise metrics and customers impacted table.
- OKR tie: this playbook maps to company OKR: "Predictable inference at scale" (Objective) -> KR: "Serve 2x baseline requests in peak with <1.5x per-token cost increase".

Notes to self / loose action items (internal):
- S1: Confirm runbook copy in Confluence (CONFLUENCE:CLARITY-6742) and attach monitoring dashboards.
- S2: Recruit two senior runtime ICs as mentors for new hires; start interviews this week.
- S3: Prep cost-estimate for burst capacity across regions; hand to Finance by T-4.

Appendix (quick links & references):
- Confluence decision doc: CONFLUENCE:CLARITY-6742
- Primary tickets: JIRA:LAUNCH-721 (launch plan), JIRA:PEAKHIRE-133 (staffing requests)
- Slack channels: #launch-rally (ops), #prod-incident (incidents), #hiring-ops (talent)
- Owner contact list (pager / mobile) attached in Confluence page.

If you are listed as an owner: please add your final confirmations to the top of the Confluence doc and reply in-thread on #launch-rally with "ACK" by EOD T-7.

-- Sasha (playbook lead)
